name: Voidbound Grimoire
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a standalone 3D-intake concept of the Voidbound Grimoire. Use the provided Whetstorm-original inventory painting as the sole visual reference for the book's identity: thick closed dark violet leather cover, central inset faceted amethyst in silver setting, restrained silver corner fittings, visible spine and page block. One entire book, three-quarter view, centered with generous margin, on a completely plain pure white background. Show a coherent solid closed book for 3D planning. No hands, people, text, lettering, symbols that resemble lettering, floor, cast shadow, logo or watermark.
constraints: 2D concept only. Existing held-offhand mapping uses tome_voidbound with VAR_BOOK grip. Grip, stow, animation, clipping and 3D fit remain unverified.
